exposure: maternal metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD)
cohort: All singleton live-born offspring in Sweden prenatally exposed to maternal biopsy-proven MASLD (1992-2017) were included and matched with reference offspring of mothers without known MASLD.
finding: The study found no evidence that prenatal exposure to maternal MASLD affects the risk of death or cancer through early adulthood in offspring.
